args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18% following its deploy. Per the SRE runbook, the service was rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions. Post-rollback status is healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure is pending investigation.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api's latest deploy (v2.3.1) was unhealthy across all production regions with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was v2.3.0.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api from v2.3.1 → v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
2. **Verified recovery:** all regions now running v2.3.0 and healthy, error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0002) documenting the failure and rollback; on-call has been paged.

Recommend following up on the incident to investigate the root cause of v2.3.1 before attempting a redeploy.
